svg.title: helicity_solver: boundary regimes, shared solver, and extension paths
svg.desc: Closed, line-tied and z-periodic magnetic domains feed a shared compatible finite-element pipeline: H(div) divergence-free projection, H(curl) curl-curl potential recovery, and boundary-specific helicity evaluation. MINRES, vertex-star geometric multigrid, block preconditioning and MPI support scalable solves. Current numerical verification and magnetic-relaxation applications are shown in solid panels; possible future extensions are shown in a dashed panel. The notation follows helicity_experiments.py: A is the recovered potential, with curl A approximating B minus B_ref; relative helicity uses A plus twice A_ref. The periodic harmonic component is B_H = B minus curl A. Field lines are schematic.

g.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Three boundary regimes. One compatible finite-element solver.
Zero normal flux on every face
Fixed normal flux at both ends
Top and bottom identified in z
Line-tied: reference field + potential · Periodic: harmonic component + flux
A: recovered potential · Bref, Aref: reference pair · BH = B − curl A
Solid panels: current code · Dashed panel: potential extensions · Field lines are schematic
